{{Quote|You can send comm signals in and out, but sensors&mdash;any kind of sensors&mdash;don't show power signatures, life signs, or metallic substances. No one's ever figured out what does it, but there's been speculation it might be some sort of mineral.|[[Alia Terae]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="RE" />}}
'''Rethel Point''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] disruption field emanating from a [[Unidentified city (Rethel Point)|ruined city]] that was located on a [[Unidentified planet (Rethel Point)|planet]]<ref name="RE" /> in the [[Far Xandil sector/Legends|Far Xandil sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

The sensor disruption field spread across most of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], growing slightly weaker the farther it stretched from the ruins of the [[City/Legends|city]], and ended just before reaching the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] paths of the planet's two small [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. It was rumored that a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Rethel]], had built the city at one [[Time/Legends|time]] long before [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. However, the ruins were so old, with so little evidence left behind by the builders, that the idea that their name had somehow survived was hard to believe.<ref name="RE" />
